They feature rectangular mouths (flue pipes). The pipes are arranged in a row within a wooden casing. The perspective is steep, looking up at the pipes.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The floral/vine patterns painted on the pipes have a slightly soft, 'smudged' appearance rather than crisp hand-painted or stenciled lines. The symmetry of the patterns across adjacent pipes is imperfect in a way that suggests AI generation rather than manufacturing consistency.

The rectangular 'mouths' of the flue pipes show inconsistencies. Some appear to have depth, while others look like flat dark patches. The upper lips of the mouths blend slightly into the pipe body without sharp geometric definition, a common AI artifact in rendering precise mechanical cutouts.
